segments.ja410:1.1: Yo maṃ pure paccuḍḍeti [paccudeti (sī. syā. pī.), paccuṭṭheti (ka.)], araññe dūramāyato;
segments.ja410:1.3: So na dissati mātaṅgo, somadatto kuhiṃ gato.
segments.ja410:2.1: Ayaṃ vā so mato seti, allasiṅgaṃva vacchito [allapiṅkava chijjito (sī. pī.), allapītaṃva vicchito (syā.)];
segments.ja410:2.3: Bhumyā nipatito seti, amarā vata kuñjaro.
segments.ja410:3.3: Samaṇassa na taṃ sādhu, yaṃ petamanusocasi.
segments.ja410:4.1: Saṃvāsena have sakka, manussassa migassa vā;
segments.ja410:4.3: Hadaye jāyate pemaṃ, taṃ na sakkā asocituṃ.
segments.ja410:5.1: Mataṃ marissaṃ rodanti, ye rudanti lapanti ca;
segments.ja410:5.3: Tasmā tvaṃ isi mā rodi, roditaṃ moghamāhu santo.
segments.ja410:6.1: Kanditena have brahme, mato peto samuṭṭhahe;
segments.ja410:7.1: Ādittaṃ vata maṃ santaṃ, ghatasittaṃva pāvakaṃ;
segments.ja410:7.3: Vārinā viya osiñcaṃ, sabbaṃ nibbāpaye daraṃ.
segments.ja410:8.1: Abbahī vata me sallaṃ, yamāsi hadayassitaṃ;
segments.ja410:9.3: Na socāmi na rodāmi, tava sutvāna vāsavāti.
